# Trellify

> A collaborative Kanban platform with real-time board sync, drag-and-drop lists
> and cards, and shared team workspaces.

Trellify is a single-page web application. Boards, columns and cards are private
to their members, so most of the product sits behind authentication and is not
crawlable.

## Pages

- [Home](https://trellify.duonggiabao.com/): Entry point; redirects to the signed-in board list or to login.
- [Login](https://trellify.duonggiabao.com/login): Email and password sign-in.
- [Register](https://trellify.duonggiabao.com/register): Account creation, followed by email verification.
- [Forgot password](https://trellify.duonggiabao.com/forgot-password): Requests a password reset link by email.

## Notes

- Boards, cards and user settings require an authenticated session.
- The API is served under `/api` on the same origin; it is not a public API.
